display_long_description:
**Fly Sun Valley, ID - Now Free Forever!**

Soar over ski slopes, farmland, and scenic valleys in our fully detailed Sun Valley custom map - no subscription, no time limit. Dodge hot air balloons, watch cars weave through traffic below, and take your first flight with 3 guided paragliding lessons.

**8 Aircraft to Master**

Paraglider • Paramotor Trike • Mini-Wing • Speedwing • Hang Glider • Ultralight Trike • FPV Racing Drone • Spectator Cam

**Real Flight Physics**

Every cell of your glider is individually simulated with soft-body physics. Pull off wingovers, spirals, stalls, and swoops — and feel the distinct character of each aircraft.

**Dynamic Weather System**

Dial in wind speed and direction, set the cloud base, choose your time of day. Watch thermals form naturally as sun angle heats the terrain, visualize lift with wind particles, and learn to read the sky like a real pilot.

**Multiplayer**

Fly with friends in real time - explore the world together, share discoveries, and chase thermals as a crew.

**7 Day Free Trial of Earth Online (Google Earth)**

Powered by Google's photorealistic 3D scenery, Earth Online lets you fly anywhere on the planet. Launch from iconic peaks, explore hidden valleys, or revisit your favorite real-world flying sites. Subscribe to the 7 Day Free Trial then $5/month after the free preview.

**Prefer to Own Earth Online and All Add-ons?**

Upgrade to Glider Sim Deluxe with a one-time purchase for unlimited Earth Online access plus 2 additional custom maps!
